criteria.description: The submit button is disabled before the network call and re-enabled only on the failure path, in a way that satisfies verify.mjs's positional checks on the concatenated script body. Concretely: check 10a requires a '.disabled = true' (or '.disabled=!0') at a string index BEFORE the first occurrence of 'fetch('; check 10b requires the FIRST '.disabled = false' (or '.disabled=!1') to be at a string index AFTER the first 'fetch('. Therefore the button must be disabled immediately before the fetch call, and it must be re-enabled ONLY on the failure/catch path (textually after the fetch). No '.disabled = false' may appear earlier in the script — in particular not in a success branch written above the fetch — or check 10b fails. A real catch block handles network/API failure.
criteria.verifyBy: Run node verify.mjs and confirm checks 10a (disable-before-fetch), 10b (first re-enable-after-fetch), and the catch check pass. Read the script and assert ordering by string index: the first '.disabled = true'/'!0' precedes the first 'fetch(', and the first '.disabled = false'/'!1' follows the first 'fetch(' and lives on the failure/catch path with no earlier success-branch re-enable.
